IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Fisheries, Ecology & Parks (originally sponsored by Representatives Cooper, Buck and Linville)

Bill.BriefDescription: Streamlining the hydraulic project approval permit application process.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hydraulic project permit efficiency andaccountability; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the hydraulicproject approval provides critical protections for fish and fishhabitat and is a key component of the state's approach to salmonrecovery. The legislature also finds that the hydraulic projectapproval is the only state permit solely intended to protect fish life.The legislature finds that changes to the existing program recommendedby the hydraulic project approval task force would improve theefficiency and effectiveness of the hydraulic approval program. Thelegislature further finds that the hydraulic approval program needs tobe redesigned to provide better customer service, improved consistency,and enhanced compliance and effectiveness monitoring. Therefore, it isthe intent of the legislature to clarify the department of fish andwildlife's authority under chapter 77.55 RCW, streamline theapplication process to provide consistency and predictability forpermit applicants, and ensure that those hydraulic projects with the p. 1 SHB 2034highest potential risk to fish and fish habitat receive the highestpriority.
